links.comparator_used: LLM-enhanced roadmaps using LLM-suggested auxiliary diagnoses without restriction to clinician-approved additions (also compared with the original clinician roadmap and expert chart review)
links.outcome: Number of missing EHR values recovered (out of 413) by roadmap-driven algorithm
links.effect: Expert chart reviews recovered 49 (12%); algorithms with LLM-enhanced roadmaps recommended 83-89 (20%-22%); final algorithm with clinician-approved LLM additions recovered 73 (18%).
links.tradeoff: Clinician approval reduced the number of recovered values relative to the unrestricted LLM-enhanced roadmaps, in exchange for clinical relevance; it still recovered more than expert chart review.
links.quote: The final algorithm using clinician-approved LLMs' additions offered a balance (73, 18%), expanding the original roadmap with LLMs' suggestions but only when deemed clinically relevant.
